findings.claim: Exact external identity, complete current pathway and formal conditions
findings.sourceFirstCheck: Returned to the Dutch programme factsheet and current year lists, then visually rechecked current OER pages31–33. The framework is60+60+60EC, with12EC selected neutrally from four restricted options and30EC genuine free space. The90ECthesis rule explicitly accepts current replacements for the older methods courses; the completed first two years meet it. Internship6/12/18EC, full first-year completion, approval/non-overlap, language testing,42ECstudy advice, capacity and assessment/attendance conditions are kept explicit. The duplicated quantitative-method code in Appendix4 does not create a missing or duplicate course: Appendix3 and the current year-page link identify BPRA200 independently. No mixed-cohort closure or invented waiver is used.

Rechecked the exact12generator,18support and11search-only rows against programme, year, careers and experience material. The strongest challenge is that a coherent environmental science or commercial-business programme would not answer a degree about public problems, policy and institutions. Five science/engineering and three commercial replacements give the climate and organisations routes sustained public, social and empirical substance. The strongest closest response includes actual public economics, constitutional law, EU policy research, civil society and organisational psychology, with quantitative and qualitative inquiry. Dedicated Dutch administration and policy-implementation sequences remain material gaps. Housing/poverty does not produce a new label for generic governance: the available catalogue lacks sustained specific housing-policy study, and Public Policy Analysis is unavailable in the planned semesters.

findings.claim: Every selected course, curricular weight and downstream claim
findings.sourceFirstCheck: Reconsidered all36selected actual enriched contents and the public-international-law addition after reading43original records. Climate science, planetary boundaries and life-cycle assessment have bounded thematic/method roles; regional project topics are externally supplied and not guaranteed policy theses. AI uses business cases; the retained venture course supports specific social innovation. Rhetoric and general ethics are complementary tools. Negotiation does not substitute for agenda setting, international conflict does not substitute for Dutch safety administration, and international business is removed as a comparative-public-administration match. Civil-society/public-sphere study provides the stronger qualified citizen relationship. Concepts, candidate ownership/stopping, schedules, traceability, distinctness, alignments and explanations were all reassessed; differences8/5/9 follow the concepts.

academicReview: Three evidence-backed related routes respond to the defining public problem, policy, institution and organisational substance. General coherence or environmental/business labels alone do not establish comparability under the CP119 distinction. Five science/engineering placements in the climate route and three generic business placements in the organisations route are replaced with stronger public, social and empirical study. Housing and poverty remain evidenced public problems; the separate candidate lacks a sustained available housing-policy sequence beyond general economics and sociology, so it is not included under a new label. Public Policy Analysis exists in the workbook but is unavailable in the planned semesters and cannot fill that gap.
